newsitem.title: USA: Pall files shelf for 720,000 treasury shrs.
newsitem.headline: Pall files shelf for 720,000 treasury shrs.

text.p: Pall Corp said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 720,000 in treasury shares of its common stock through Dillon, Read & Co.

The company intends to use the net proceeds from the sale of the shares for general corporate purposes, which may include reduction of debt, funding Pall's capital expenditure program and working capital.

Pall, is worldwide supplier of fine filters, mainly made by Pall using its high-quality filter media and other fluid clarification equipment for the removal of solid, liquid and gaseous contaminants from a wide variety of liquids and gases.
